name: copilot-usage-dashboard
description: Local statistics about how you use GitHub Copilot: models, chat vs inline, agents, skills, prompt types, projects, days and hours.

copilotUsage.projectGroups.markdownDescription: Your projects. Easiest to manage with the **Copilot Usage: Add or Edit Project** command or the **+ Project** button in the dashboard. Keys are project names, values are workspace folder names or glob patterns (`*` matches anything, case-insensitive). Workspaces not in any project are shown under their own folder name.

copilotUsage.trackInline.description: Estimate accepted inline (ghost text) completions by watching large single insertions that are not pastes. Stored locally in VS Code global state.

copilotUsage.inlineMinChars.description: Minimum inserted characters for an edit to count as an accepted inline completion.

copilotUsage.statusBar.description: Show today's chat and inline counts in the status bar.

copilotUsage.extraChatFolders.description: Additional VS Code 'User' folders to scan (e.g. Code - Insiders).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces, folder-specific chat.*FilesLocations settings are ignored when scanning the workspace's AI setup.
